## 📝 改动说明 / Description

<!-- 简要描述本次改动的内容与动机 / Briefly describe what has changed and why -->

## 🔗 关联 Issue / Related Issue

<!-- 例如 / e.g. Closes #123 -->

## 🏷️ 变更类型 / Type of Change

- [ ] feat: 新功能 / New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug 修复 / Bug fix
- [ ] refactor: 重构 / Refactor
- [ ] skin / ui: 视觉与交互调整 / Visual & UX tweaks
- [ ] ci: 构建与 CI / Build & CI
- [ ] chore / docs: 其他杂项 / Miscellaneous

## ✅ 自查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` 通过（含 vue-tsc 类型检查）/ `pnpm build` passes (incl. vue-tsc type check)
- [ ] 已在至少一个平台实际测试，平台：____ / Tested on at least one platform, namely: ____
- [ ] 涉及 UI 的改动已附截图 / Screenshots attached for UI changes
- [ ] 不涉及「不在计划内」的功能（回帖、发帖、自动签到、吧务管理）/ Does not involve out-of-scope features (replying, posting, auto check-in, moderation)

## 📷 截图 / Screenshots

<!-- UI 改动请粘贴改动前后的对比截图 / Before & after screenshots for UI changes -->
